summary: Iteration 27 — schedule toggle, gate-unlock logging, abuse dashboard fields, and friendly error path all validated. Backend pytest: 5/5 passing (POST /api/admin/collateral/ai-refresh-schedule flips scheduled on and off; GET /api/admin/collateral/ai-refresh-status returns full shape {running,total,done,finished_at,scheduled,last_auto_run}; POST /api/collateral/unlock inserts masked email into db.gate_unlocks and it surfaces in GET /api/admin/security under gate_unlocks[] with unlocks_today >= 1; /admin/security response now carries download_activity {top:[{title,category,downloads,downloads_week}], downloads_today, total} and gate_unlocks/unlocks_today alongside existing banned/alerts/offenders/trend; wrong-password login still returns 401 so frontend can distinguish it from 5xx friendly-busy). Frontend admin (/admin): Overview 'Download activity' (download-spikes) and 'Recent gate unlocks' (gate-unlocks) panels both render inside abuse-activity grid; Collateral tab (admin-tab-collateral) shows collateral-refresh-panel with the new collateral-schedule-toggle checkbox — toggling flips scheduled false→true, success toast 'Monthly auto-refresh ON — runs on the 1st of each month.' fires, and after full page reload the checked state persists (verified true→true, then reset to OFF as cleanup). The collateral-bulk-refresh button was NOT clicked. Friendly-error UI path: could not be exercised in-browser because the /login form's hCaptcha widget blocks submit before the API call fires (both the intercepted-502 case and the wrong-password case surfaced 'Please complete the captcha.' first). The friendlyAuthError() helper in AuthContext.js is however correctly wired (returns the 'briefly busy' string on no-response / 5xx / non-JSON body / 520/522/524, and passes through Pydantic detail otherwise) and Login.jsx + Register.jsx both use it in catch blocks — code path validated by inspection.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~7400 lines — collateral/schedule/security surface still deserves its own module (recurring since iter 25/26).
FastAPI @app.on_event startup/shutdown remains deprecated — migrate to lifespan handlers.

_digest_scheduler() runs _bulk_ai_refresh on the 1st of the month based on last_auto_run, but there is no stale-lock guard on app_meta.collateral_refresh.running — if a scheduled auto-run crashes mid-way, running stays true and every future refresh (auto or manual) will 409 until DB is manually reset. Add a TTL/started_at-based stale-lock recovery.

collateral_unlock() logs an event to db.gate_unlocks on every POST including when the email is invalid or missing (email_masked becomes '—'). Consider only logging when EMAIL_RE matches to keep the abuse dashboard clean; today an attacker spamming the endpoint with empty payloads inflates unlocks_today with '—' rows.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for testable paths (schedule toggle + persistence + overview panels). Friendly-error UI branch not exercisable in-browser due to captcha guard; code path verified by source review.
